StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:137-140) adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

guards.what: EnragePower.cs:17 `cardPlay.Card.Type == CardType.Skill` -- and NO ownership test
guards.rationale: powers.py:431 tests CardType.SKILL and likewise does not test ownership. The absent owner check is C#'s, not an omission: EnragePower.cs:15-22 reacts to ANY Skill played by anyone, unlike Corruption and Feel No Pain, which both gate on card.Owner.Creature. The sim matches, and in single-player the distinction is unobservable anyway.

powers.py:432-433 routes through StrengthCmd.apply (cmds.py:1155-1167), which runs a modify_strength_given chain C# does not have at this site and drops `applier = Owner`. Same shape, same reasoning and same non-observability as the matching guards on power/ritual and power/demon_form; kept as a divergence because PossessStrengthPower (powers.py:3942-3951) is the ported effect that reads a Strength application's applier.

guards.what: Enrage fires once per CardPlay, not once per Replay iteration
guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: combat.py's `_play_count_loop` (combat.py:1147-1153+) now builds the play bracket INSIDE `for play_index in range(play_count)` -- `before_card_played` at :1155 and `on_card_played` at :1209 both fire once per replay iteration, mirroring CardModel.cs:1904-1965 (Hook.BeforeCardPlayed :1929 and Hook.AfterCardPlayed :1959, both inside the playCount loop). RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-04 (line numbers only) by reading `CombatState._play_count_loop`. WAS: both fired once per logical play, outside the loop, so a Throwing-Axe- or Duplication-doubled card advanced every Before/AfterCardPlayed listener by 1 where the game advances it by 2.
